construct: Most adult Refsum disease is caused by biallelic PHYH variants that impair peroxisomal phytanoyl-CoA hydroxylase, blocking alpha-oxidation of phytanic acid and causing systemic phytanic-acid accumulation.

adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: Retinitis pigmentosa, anosmia, neuropathy, ataxia, ichthyosis, markedly high phytanic acid, and normal VLCFAs define adult Refsum disease from impaired peroxisomal alpha-oxidation of phytanic acid.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: VLCFA beta-oxidation defects cause different peroxisomal disorders and would not fit normal VLCFAs; MCAD affects mitochondrial medium-chain oxidation; GALC deficiency causes Krabbe disease; BCAA oxidation failure causes MSUD.
adversarial_second_pass.expert_reviewer_reversal: The combination of high phytanic acid with normal VLCFAs specifically localizes the defect to phytanic-acid alpha-oxidation rather than generalized peroxisomal beta-oxidation.
